hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with a time-decaying dynamic fee curve. The hook overrides pool LP fees to zero and skims fees via return deltas, distributing them between a creator recipient, treasury, permanently-locked LP compounding, and holder reflections (via IDividendToken.notifyReward). Whitelisted launch wallets pay the floor fee during the opening window.
